g.text: An influence line gives a chosen beam response as a unit load moves along the span

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #59636c

g.text: Simply supported ideal beam, downward moving unit force. Reaction influence ordinate is dimensionless; moment influence ordinate has length units.
Multiply by a point-load magnitude or integrate distributed load times influence ordinate to obtain that load effect. This is an influence line, not a
bending-moment diagram for one fixed load position.
